text: B.A. Insurance Objectives: This program trains students with the theories of insurance and skills of professional transactions. Graduates are fit for jobs in insurance companies, insurance inter-firms, financial organizations and enterprises covering the fields of insurance management, insurance financial planning and risk management. Objects: Four-year Bachelor of Economics Degree Main Courses: Monetary and Banking, Management, Economic Law, Public Finance, Risk Management, Principles of Insurance, Operation and Management of Insurance Companies, Properties Insurance, Life Insurance, Accuracy Mathematics, Insurance Accounting, Insurance Marketing, Re-Insurance, Ocean Insurance, Law of Insurance, Insurance Investment, Financial Management, etc.
